description: This Java class 'ApiParameterHelper' provides static utility methods for extracting and processing query parameters from HTTP requests, such as command IDs, response fields, associations, locale, and various boolean flags, used within the Fineract API infrastructure.

classes.name: ApiParameterHelper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to parse and handle API query parameters.

methods.name: commandId
methods.description: Extracts the command ID as a Long from query parameters.

methods.name: extractFieldsForResponseIfProvided
methods.description: Returns a set of requested response fields based on 'fields' query parameter.

methods.name: extractAssociationsForResponseIfProvided
methods.description: Returns a set of associations for response based on 'associations' query parameter.

methods.name: excludeAssociationsForResponseIfProvided
methods.description: Removes specified associations from the fields set based on 'exclude' parameter.

methods.name: extractLocale
methods.description: Extracts Locale object from 'locale' query parameter.

methods.name: parameterType
methods.description: Returns true if 'parameterType' query parameter is set to 'true'.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Returns true if 'template' query parameter is set to 'true'.

methods.name: makerCheckerable
methods.description: Returns true if 'makerCheckerable' query parameter is set to 'true'.

methods.name: includeJson
methods.description: Returns true if 'includeJson' query parameter is set to 'true'.

methods.name: genericResultSet
methods.description: Returns true if 'genericResultSet' query parameter is set to 'true'.

methods.name: genericResultSetPassed
methods.description: Checks if 'genericResultSet' parameter is present in query parameters.
